ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future case, including the alleged $300 million sent to the Argentine soccer body.
questions: What were the exact mechanisms of the alleged fraud?
How did the money get laundered?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale money laundering operation and shed light on the accountability of nonprofit organizations.

ideas.title: The Treehouse Daycare Investigation: A Pattern of Neglect?
ideas.description: Investigate the Treehouse daycare case, including the missing child and lack of 911 call.
questions: What were the warning signs leading up to the incident?
How did the state fail to prevent this?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal systemic failures in the oversight of daycare centers and the protection of children.
